'''Khasva''' were a species of fish indigenous to [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. They could be eaten fried.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] once brought home khasva rolls for dinner with his wife, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> These rolls were also called [[Sushi/Legends|sushi]].<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref>
